$description: LAYER 1 — Global semantic colors (light), Template B (Harvard-PLL / tels-mirror). Change color.primary.base once → buttons, links, tabs, selects, TinyMCE accents. Applied via CSS vars; bridges only rematch selectors.

green.$description: Base green (feeds Success when linked) — tels-mirror --brand-success

base.$description: UI label: Primary — Harvard crimson, cascades to solid primary button bg and related primary uses (tels-mirror --brand-primary)

soft.$description: Marketing primary tint surface (badges, icon chips, soft CTAs) → --pgn-color-primary-soft (tels-mirror --brand-primary-soft)

border.$description: Marketing chrome + public page borders (header/footer, cards, form fields, filter pills) → --pgn-color-chrome-border (tels-mirror --border)

surface-subtle.$description: Marketing chrome + public page subtle surface (search field bg, alternating section bg) → --pgn-color-chrome-surface-subtle (tels-mirror --surface-subtle)

surface-warm.$description: Public page alt-section surface → --pgn-color-chrome-surface-warm. tels-mirror has one subtle off-white, no separate warm tone — same value as surface-subtle here.

header-dark.$description: Header's scrolled/catalog dark navy state, subject mega-menu bg, catalog/legal page dark title band → --pgn-color-chrome-header-dark. Measured from the live pll.harvard.edu .site-header.scroll background (#293352) — supersedes tels-mirror's own approximation (Tailwind bg-[#263557]).

footer.$description: Footer body text on dark footer band → --pgn-color-text-footer (tels-mirror footer uses plain text-white)

link.$description: Footer link color → --pgn-color-footer-link (tels-mirror: plain white, hover → primary)

border.$description: Footer dividers and social rings → --pgn-color-footer-border (tels-mirror border-white/10)
